ledgerRowArithmetic: the BL-14 gate counts SHARED-LEDGER ROWS, not spawns: 1 pre-registration (intent) row per lease, so 20 boots need maxStarts = 21. unallocated: only for a re-run of a named failure class, never to retry the same class twice

rules: Every boot goes through the BL-14 pre-registration gate (tests/world-factory/suites/150-a5sf-read.mjs#readBudgetGrant) with a per-run grant file bound to the HEAD that runs; no ad-hoc spawn.

The shared ledger (tests/world-factory/lib/run-record.mjs) stays the ONE counter and ONE writer; a run that would exceed its allocation refuses with BUDGET_NOT_GRANTED rather than borrowing from another item.
The reserve is not a slush fund: it may only re-run a NEW failure class that no allocation predicted, and the reason is recorded in the run's evidence.
No boot may touch the stable instance :3080 or its DSH_HOME; test homes live under tests/homes/<world> only.
A boot that produces no Host-attributable observation is still spent: the ledger row is the cost, and 'we learned nothing' is recorded as such rather than quietly retried.
